title: Provider Cache Usage Evidence
description: Canonical evidence row recording observed cloud-provider prompt/context caching behavior and usage metadata for a single invocation. Content-light: never stores raw prompts, completions, provider payloads, secrets, or API keys.

provider_kind.description: Cloud provider or platform that served this invocation.

platform_kind.description: Platform variant when the provider offers multiple caching surfaces.

model_safe_id.description: Content-light model identifier. Does not include API keys, secrets, or raw credentials.

request_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the normalized request envelope. Null when request-digest extraction is deferred or unavailable.

context_packet_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the sanitized context packet assembled for this invocation. Null when unavailable.

privacy_class.description: Privacy classification of the context submitted to this invocation.

cache_mode_requested.description: Cache mode Rig Relay requested, if any. 'no_request_issued' means Rig Relay made no explicit cache request.

cache_mode_observed.description: Cache behavior observed in the provider response. 'no_cache_activity' = usage fields present but zero. 'cache_activity_unknown' = no usage fields returned.

cache_resource_safe_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the explicit cache resource identifier (e.g. Google cachedContent name), when one was referenced. Null for automatic caches or when not applicable.

ttl_class.description: Observed or requested TTL class for this cache entry. Null when not applicable.

cached_input_token_count.description: Number of input tokens served from cache (cache hits). Maps to OpenAI cached_tokens, Anthropic cache_read_input_tokens, Gemini cachedContentTokenCount. Null when unavailable.

cache_write_input_token_count.description: Number of input tokens written to cache (cache creation). Maps to Anthropic cache_creation_input_tokens. Null when provider does not distinguish read from write.

cache_hit_reported.description: True when the provider reported a cache hit via usage metadata. False when usage fields are zero or absent. True does not guarantee the cache hit was complete.

estimated_cost_effect_class.description: Estimated cost effect for this invocation based on observed cache activity and known provider pricing.

user_approval_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the step-up authorization receipt, if one was required and issued for cache use. Null when no approval was required.

retention_disclosure_class.description: Retention class for this cache entry per provider documentation and observed evidence.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this evidence event was recorded.

evidence_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the canonical evidence row payload, excluding this field.

content_light.description: Never stores raw prompts, completions, provider payloads, secrets, or API keys.
